reason: The local fuel plant needs carbon dioxide, so connecting the receiver to the capture unit seems like a useful first step.
expectation: I expect the receiver to collect compressed carbon dioxide, though the exact result is uncertain.

alternatives.reason: I also considered starting water separation at the hydrogen outlet, but chose to prepare the carbon dioxide supply first.

effect: The receiver produced compressed carbon dioxide and completed that goal, leaving water separation to address.
reaction: The result matched my expectation, though it gave little detail about the capture process.
reason: I’ll start at the hydrogen outlet to work toward separating water into hydrogen and oxygen.
expectation: I expect to obtain hydrogen from the water, though I’m unsure how the oxygen will be handled.

alternatives.reason: The oxygen outlet also serves the separation goal, but I chose to start with hydrogen.

effect: The plant produced hydrogen and clarified that oxygen comes from the other outlet of the same running electrolysis process.
reaction: The clarification about the shared process was useful; I had been unsure how the oxygen would be handled.
reason: Collecting oxygen is the only available combination and should complete the water separation goal.
expectation: I expect to collect the oxygen stream from the running electrolyzer.

effect: Collecting oxygen completed the chapter and clarified that the lander will use it as an oxidizer, separate from the hydrogen.
reaction: The distinction between oxidizer and fuel was useful, though the chapter ended before I saw how the supplies would be used.

mostWorthwhile.text: Collecting hydrogen was most worthwhile because the explanation clarified that both gases come from the same running electrolysis process.

leastWorthwhile.text: Capturing carbon dioxide was the least informative passage: it completed the goal without explaining the capture or compression process.

surprise.text: I had been unsure how oxygen would be handled; the result explained that it comes from the other outlet of the same process.

arbitrary.text: The two separate outlet actions felt somewhat mechanical, but their purpose was clear once the shared process was explained.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the fuel plant is used and whether the untouched ice can be brought home; this chapter left both developments open.
